descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15; TFA-92599 AC 10 · “the Post-Round tab shows a "generating" state, and the note appears when ready”.

Bug N17 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S1 · no longer counted

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved). Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: the note is a server job; reload or leaving during Generate shows a generating state, then the note (dev: OAT-03/S15, TC-14/S07, S26, TC-21/S28 10/10, TC-17/S27).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S07, TC-14/S26, OAT-03/S15, TC-25/S14, TC-17/S27

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S28 Nursing Home Save & Extract and Generate: time, model, and the 'generating' state while the physician moves on

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6) (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Two NH residents, the first with a typed synthetic encounter; 10 cycles, NH only (the feature is mode-specific)

When Tap Save & Extract; tap Generate Note & Finish and immediately open the second resident; come back to the first

Then While away, the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and the note is there on return, or an explicit failure shows. Each step logs durationMs and providerMs and the model/provider (aiCallLog).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pass/Fail: the 'generating' state is shown and the note (or an explicit failure) is there on return (3.5). Timings are targets, not pass/fail (3.5): record total vs providerMs per step, and flag any run over 30 s where the non-AI share (total − providerMs) is the larger part, for review with Vikram. Model per step (3.9). NH Save Note timing is TC-10 S19. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-21/S28

Nursing Home Save & Extract and Generate: time, model, and the 'generating' state while the physician moves on

Tickets: TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Local 25acd727, 10 cycles, Nursing Home only, fresh residents per cycle. Save & Extract answered at the socket at once; Generate answered with an injected failure after 8 s (on this build a stored note queues the server billing job, so a successful local Generate is not allowed); the note save is refused at the socket too. Each cycle: Save & Extract, Generate Note & Finish, open the second resident at once, come back to the first ~2.4 s after Generate (model still 'working'), then wait past the failure. Save & Extract worked 10/10 (U9). 'Generating Note…' shows before leaving (10/10, recorded), but on return it is gone 0/10 (Encounter idle, Post-Round 'No note generated yet.'), and after the failure no error is shown 0/10: the generating state and the failure live in the unmounted tab. Known: candidate N17 (generation is not on the server; TFA-92592 AC 'generation runs on the server … on return the note is there, or an explicit failure shows'). The generation code is unchanged from 43c38a4f (no diff in useNoteGeneration.ts / snf EncounterTab.tsx).

Product issue: A physician who taps Generate on a resident and moves to the next one finds no 'generating' state when coming back, and if the note failed no error is shown: the visit just looks like it was never generated (N17).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: variants. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev newspec-c] passed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: passed → passed (passed) Dev 8b4be94a, 10 cycles with the real server job: the note reached Post-Round in 10/10; in the 8 cycles where it was not yet written when the physician came back, Post-Round showed a 'generating' state (8/8); in 2 the note was already there; 'Complete the Encounter tab first' 0/10. Generate sends noteJobs:request (server job). Note: the spec's own judge reporte…
